Those given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their own sons, but those who lose themselves will not believe.
No one is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies His verses, and the wrongdoers will not succeed.
On the Day of gathering the polytheists will be asked where their claimed partners are, and they will swear they never associated others, lying about themselves.
Some listen with covered hearts and deaf ears, would not believe any sign, call the revelation legends of former peoples, and keep others away from the Prophet, destroying only themselves.
Standing before the Fire, they will wish to be returned and not deny the signs, but if returned they would repeat what was forbidden, for they are liars.
They say there is only worldly life and no resurrection, yet before their Lord they will admit the truth, taste punishment, and regret when the Hour comes suddenly.
Worldly life is only amusement and diversion, while the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah.
They reject Allah's verses, not the Prophet; earlier messengers bore denial patiently, had Allah willed He would have united them on guidance, and only those who hear respond.
Allah can send the sign they demand; every creature and bird forms a community gathered to its Lord, while deniers of His verses are deaf and dumb in darkness.
If Allah's punishment or the Hour came, people would invoke Him alone, and He would remove it if He willed, while they forget what they associated with Him.
Nations before were seized with poverty and hardship to humble them; when they hardened and forgot, Allah opened every good to them, then seized them suddenly and eliminated the wrongdoers.
If Allah took away hearing and sight and sealed hearts, no other deity could restore them; and if His punishment came, only the wrongdoing people would be destroyed.
Messengers are sent only to bring good tidings and warn: believers who reform have no fear or grief, while those who deny the verses will be punished.
The Prophet says he holds no depositories of Allah, does not know the unseen and is not an angel; he only follows what is revealed to him.
The Prophet is told to warn with the Quran those who fear the gathering, not to send away those who call on their Lord, and to greet believers with peace.
The Prophet declares he is forbidden to worship what they invoke, stands on clear evidence from his Lord, and does not hold what they impatiently demand; the decision is Allah's.
Allah holds the keys of the unseen and knows everything on land and in the sea, every falling leaf and grain, all written in a clear record.
Allah takes souls by night and revives people by day until their term ends; guardian angels watch them until His messengers take them at death, and all return to Him.
Allah alone rescues people from the darknesses of land and sea, yet they associate others; He can send affliction from above or below or confuse them into sects.
The Prophet's people deny the truth; he is to turn from those who talk offensively of the verses, leave those who take religion as amusement, and remind with the Quran.
Believers will not invoke what neither benefits nor harms after Allah has guided them, for Allah's guidance is the only guidance; they are commanded to submit, pray and fear Him.
Allah created the heavens and earth in truth; when He says Be, it is, His is the dominion on the Day the Horn is blown, and He knows the unseen.
Abraham rebukes his father Azar for taking idols, sees a star, the moon and the sun set, turns to the Creator alone, and argues with his people.
Allah guided Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Noah, David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, Aaron, Zechariah, John, Jesus, Elias, Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah and Lot; follow their guidance.
Those who say Allah revealed nothing to a human are asked who revealed the Scripture Moses brought, which they make into pages, showing some and concealing much.
This blessed Book confirms what came before, to warn the Mother of Cities and those around it; those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it and maintain their prayers.
No one is more unjust than one who falsely claims revelation; at death the angels demand the wrongdoers' souls, and they come to Allah alone, without their claimed intercessors.
Allah splits grain and seed, brings the living from the dead, makes the night, sun, moon and stars, produced people from one soul, and sends rain for crops and fruit.
They make the jinn partners with Allah and invent sons and daughters for Him, but He has no companion or son; there is no deity except Him, the Creator.
Insight has come from Allah, so whoever sees benefits himself; the verses are varied so the disbelievers say the Prophet studied, and to make the Quran clear.
The Prophet is told to follow what is revealed to him and turn from those who associate others with Allah, for he is not their guardian or manager.
Do not insult those they invoke besides Allah, lest they insult Allah in enmity without knowledge; every community's deeds are made pleasing to it.
They swear they would believe if a sign came, but they would not, even if angels came down and the dead spoke to them, unless Allah willed.
Every prophet was given enemies, devils from mankind and jinn, who inspire one another with decorative speech that draws those who disbelieve in the Hereafter.
Allah has revealed the Book explained in detail, and those given the Scripture know it is true; His word is fulfilled in truth and justice, and none can alter it.
Most people on earth would mislead from Allah's way, following only assumption, and Allah knows best who strays from His way and who is guided.
Eat what Allah's name has been mentioned over and not what it has not; what is forbidden is detailed except under compulsion, and leave sin, apparent and concealed.
One who was dead and given life and light to walk among people is not like one in darkness who never emerges.
Every city has its greatest criminals conspiring, but only against themselves; they demand what the messengers were given and will suffer debasement and severe punishment.
Allah opens the breast of whom He would guide to Islam and constricts whom He would misguide; His path is straight, and those who remember have the Home of Peace.
